items.title: Isaiah Morgan Interview, 1958-12-01
items.q: The first four? Margie. That was the first thing. That was the first of us.

ctx.x: I was wondering, what were those first four tunes that you played? Do you remember the first four tunes that you played?
The first four? Margie. That was the first thing. That was the first thing. That was the first of us. And Dolomite, Dolomite, Dolomite, Dolomite of Dynamite. Now the others, I don't know.
About what year was it you got those numbers?
